name: Champion Dark Alert — Daily GTM Automation

nodes.name: Daily Schedule (8am Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 8am. CSMs see alerts at the start of their day.

nodes.name: Fetch Accounts from CRM
nodes.notes: In production: HubSpot/Salesforce API. For demo: swap with Read Binary File node pointing at the xlsx export.

nodes.name: Evaluate Compound Trigger
nodes.notes: Three-gate filter. All three must pass to generate an alert. Tune thresholds in env vars.

nodes.name: Any Accounts Triggered?
nodes.notes: True branch: accounts to alert. False branch: log 'no triggers today' and stop.

nodes.name: Generate Alert (Claude API)
nodes.notes: Claude generates a context-specific, actionable alert for each account. Not a template — each alert is unique.

nodes.name: Format Slack Payload
nodes.notes: Wraps alert in Slack Block Kit. Red=overdue, orange=<30d, yellow=<90d. Routes to correct CSM channel.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Webhook URL stored in n8n credentials. Can be per-CSM channel or a shared #cs-alerts channel.

nodes.name: Log to Audit Trail
nodes.notes: In production: write to Google Sheets 'Alert Log' tab or INSERT into alerts table. Enables reporting on alert → outcome tracking.

parameters.body: ={"text": "⚠️ Champion Dark Alert workflow error: {{ $json.message }}. Check n8n execution log."}

nodes.name: Error → Slack Engineering
nodes.notes: Any node failure routes here. Posts to #gtm-engineering. Prevents silent failures.

meta.description: Detects champion disengagement + renewal proximity + stale CSM notes. Generates AI-written Slack alerts for assigned CSMs. Runs daily at 8am weekdays.
meta.author: Valentino
